title: Salt Ledger Days
setting_summary: A tidal salt-harvesting station on a shrinking island where every bucket, hour, and breath is logged by a single ledger, and the tide decides who eats. The station's Warden enforces quotas while rumors of a mainland audit stir quiet rebellion among the crew. Each entry traces how small acts of dignity, speech, and fairness collide with the ledger's cold arithmetic.
